correctness.rationale: PASS: Kummer applies since 4n+1 is odd; binomial parity is no overlap of binary n and 4n. The maximum predecessor suffix follows the greedy high-to-low condition with forbidden distance-2 one-bits; the displayed four-step recurrences produce floor(2^j/5), floor(3*2^j/5) gaps. Endpoints 2^j and 3*2^j realize the two cases. Interlacing proves first occurrence records; independent Fibonacci counts on even/odd bit positions give the support census. Fresh enumeration for n<65536 found 3025 odd indices, 26 positive lengths and the expected first record endpoints; numerical evidence is corroborative only.
